label: 探索性 (EXPLORATORY)
status_statement: Stage B was judged NOT PASSED. Everything in H4178 is exploratory, is not a formal confirmation, and does not change the stage-B verdict.

frozen_version.switches: hooks/sitecustomize.py + hooks/h4178_ablation_hooks.py (post-import patches, inert when empty)

modes.strict: strict S3: no landing exemption at all

judge.S3_success: CUT->real release in order petiole2, petiole0, stalk1 within the 3600-frame episode; every CUT with the original physical gates before/after and permitted post-physics identity; physical exit of each released object (h4178_physical: 3 consecutive boundaries with all tool-object pairs >= 2 mm and no positive force); environment success event; zero safety failures; complete evidence
judge.safety: native 144-pair reconstruction at every boundary; non-Blade < 2 mm or positive force outside the exemption; Blade outside current-cut / cut-boundary / just-released / non-worsening scope; CUT without gates; wrong/duplicate/mistimed release; solver-substep non-Blade force; landing force > 300 N / penetration > 8 mm (landing mode)
judge.not_part_of_S3: the frozen controller-internal 240-frame object clock (reported only)
recorded_per_run: dangerous executed/requested CUT (full temporal interlock or its shadow not permitted)

uniform_administrative_stop: baselines: no new real release within 480 frames of the previous release (episode start) -> stop; every unit: 180-minute wall cap

predictions.CONTROL: Same as stage B: 3/3 full harvest under S3+landing (CUT 28 / 355-356 / 585-588), safety passed; strict S3 fails 3/3 at the released-P0 landing (P0 on the fingers, frames ~359-374; this is what the landing exemption covers).
predictions.AB1_landing: P2 identical to control. Without the literal landing program, post-window route and admission, the released P0 still falls onto the fingers (physics), so strict S3 is violated 3/3 at frames ~357-375; the controller (final screens without admission) stops at the P0 exit stage before the stalk. Predicted 0/3 success; furthest stage P0 release; strict-S3 safety violation expected (reported, queue continues).
predictions.AB2_stalk_brake: P2 and P0 identical to control. At the stalk the contact cannot be held long enough for the original settling/permission checks (as in development runs H4168040: native forecast rejected at 596; H4172040: pre-CUT contact permission lost at 585). Predicted 0/3, stop near frames 580-600 before the stalk CUT, safe (no violation).
predictions.AB3_e3g: E3g only acts when the cached entry contact is shallow; in the nominal state the controller is byte-identical to H4176 (stage A). Predicted 3/3 success identical to control; first-cut entry NOT failing.
predictions.AB4_zero_manifold: In stage-B nominal runs the zero-force detection-neighbour admission was used only at the stalk (frames 583-587, Blade zero-force manifold with petiole 1). Prediction: the FIRST petiole is NOT rejected; P2 and P0 identical; the stalk CUT is refused (temporal_noncurrent_manifold) and the run stops at the stalk stage, 0/3, safe.
predictions.AB5_temporal: In stage-B nominal runs the temporal look-ahead blocked a legacy-permitted frame only at 581-582 (stalk). Without it: P2/P0 identical; at the stalk a CUT can be requested/executed 1-6 frames earlier while the shadow full interlock says not permitted -> dangerous requests >= 1 per run expected; nonblade <2 mm frames, wrong releases: 0 predicted; success uncertain (predicted 2/3). Safety is the measured quantity (no stop on AB5 violations).
predictions.AB6_init_screening: Static only: at the original nominal reset joint state with the registered Root the arm is predicted to violate the 144-pair 2 mm rule (pairs < 2 mm, possibly interpenetrating), i.e. the run would not be allowed to start.
predictions.AB7_live_cold: Live-pause three-cold qualification only verifies reproducibility of the paused P0 exit; physics and decisions unchanged. Predicted 3/3 success identical to control, without the 3 cold processes.
predictions.BL1: Fixed target library (E servo, no contact model, no safety layer): predicted 0/3 S3 on scene 11; furthest stage at most P2 CUT; non-Blade contacts likely (safety violations reported).
predictions.BL2: Frozen v5 online DLS IK + contact search, no repair, no interlock: predicted 0/3; may reach P2 contact/CUT; non-Blade violations likely.
predictions.BL3: Locked axis repair over BL2: predicted 0/3; similar to BL2, possibly fewer alignment failures.
predictions.BL4: Object-level candidate v8r3 (temporal interlock, hover, stabilizer; no handoff/exit/landing modules): predicted 0/3; may cut P2 but fail at release/exit or P0.
predictions.BL5: OMPL RRTConnect, kinematic plan to the IK cut pose: predicted 0/3; collision-free transit likely, but CUT gates (contact/blade face) and released-object landing are not modelled -> stop at P2 CUT dwell or later violation.
predictions.EXP3A: Ours: 9/10 tiers cannot start (stage-B frozen-route screening), CONTACT 0/3 (stage B). Baselines: predicted 0 successes on every tier.
predictions.EXP3B: Ours: predicted to stop at screening (frozen h1090 path qualification) or before the first CUT on every unseen scene. Baselines: predicted 0 successes.

stop_rules.disk: free >= 1500 MiB before every launch, otherwise stop; unit NOT_STARTED
stop_rules.strict_denominator: started = counted; not started = NOT_STARTED; no rerun or overwrite; no parameter change after results
stop_rules.safety: any safety violation under the unit registered judgement mode (all units except AB5): write SAFETY_STOP_REPORT, report to the user, then continue (stop-report-continue)

statistics.unit: scene or tier; same-scene repeats are descriptive only
statistics.paired: exact McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs) for paired method comparisons on the same initial state and seed
statistics.intervals: Wilson 95% descriptive only, never generalisation claims
statistics.pooling: never pooled across versions or with H4176 / stage A / stage B

Earlier attempts archived unchanged.
step0_disclosures.probe_runs: H4178P*_ cases are step-0 screening boots (no harvest command); not method runs; not in any result denominator
